{"objective":"Use the ink workshop records to explain competing explanations and design an executable comparison of ink formula with fair measurement and independent experimental units.","inputs":[{"id":"ink-a","text":"Fictional workshop record A: cards stamped with water-based ink were tested at 18 °C. The recorded median drying time was 90 seconds."},{"id":"ink-b","text":"Workshop record B: cards stamped with gel ink were tested at 26 °C. The recorded median drying time was 60 seconds. The original run log does not report sample sizes or individual readings."},{"id":"ink-design","text":"Planning brief for a new test, not collected results: investigate ink formula while controlling room temperature. There are 32 fresh cards; one card is an experimental unit and can receive either ink. Retain the same card stock, stamped area and ink volume. The outcome is drying time in seconds. Measurement rule: start timing at stamping, then press a fresh clean test strip lightly at five-second intervals until no ink transfers; record that elapsed time for each card. The available temperature settings are 18 °C and 26 °C."}]}

{"objective":"引用杯子保温记录解释同时改变的条件，设计可执行的保温套比较，并区分独立实验单位、重复读数及尚未取得的结果。","inputs":[{"id":"cup-a","text":"虚构记录甲：带保温套的一组杯子，起始水温为40 °C，十分钟后的温度为36 °C。"},{"id":"cup-b","text":"记录乙：不带保温套的一组杯子，起始水温为30 °C，十分钟后的温度为27 °C。旧记录没有提供每组杯数和每杯读数。"},{"id":"cup-design","text":"新试验的准备条件，尚未实施：研究保温套，同时控制起始水温。可用24只同款新杯子；一只杯子是一个实验单位，每只均可加上或不加保温套。保留相同杯型、每杯200 mL水量和相同室内环境。结果指标为十分钟内温度下降值。测量规则：用同一校准规则的温度计记录每杯开始时与十分钟后的摄氏温度，以起始值减去结束值，逐杯保存。可选择的起始水温为40 °C或30 °C。"}]}

{"objective":"Combine unequal group counts to calculate a return proportion, distinguish tablet weighting from desk weighting, and separate a descriptive result from an explanation of desk performance.","inputs":[{"id":"tablet-desks","text":"Fictional library service note: the small desk issued twelve loaner tablets during the trial week; nine came back before closing. One colleague instead proposes giving the two desk percentages equal weight. The library also operated a staff equipment service, whose records are not included here."}]}
